Denge Yatirim Holding AS ( (TR:DENGE) ) has shared an update.

Denge Yatirim Holding AS has published a detailed Participation Finance Principles information form for the first half of 2026, confirming that its articles of association, operational activities and share structure contain no explicitly prohibited sectors or privileges under participation finance rules. The company reports that none of its income derives from core activities such as alcohol, pork, gambling, conventional financial services or other areas directly contrary to participation finance, and that revenue from activities allowed only within a 5% tolerance is effectively zero.

Despite this, the disclosure shows that 6.2% of total income, 45.44% of assets and 61.21% of liabilities are classified as not complying with participation finance principles, largely due to the structure of its financial investments and borrowings. These ratios indicate that while the company avoids outright prohibited business lines, its balance sheet still contains a high share of non-participation-compliant instruments, a factor that may limit its appeal to strictly participation-focused investors and could require further balance sheet adjustment if it seeks full alignment.
